videos.script: A step is idempotent when running it twice leaves what running it once left. {{definition}} Every orchestrator in this course runs steps twice. Retries, clears, backfills. {{twice}} Ana's naive load inserts a day of sales. Run it twice on top of the nightly, and the day is in the table three times. Nothing fails. {{triple}} The real load deletes the day first. Run it twice, and the fingerprint does not move. {{replace}} She turns the claim into a test, and runs it over every step of the nightly. {{test}} A log of loads is never the same twice, and should not be. {{log}} And the fact table stops drifting. Each night it rebuilds the last thirty days, safely, because it can.
